proposed_widenings.name: non-spell ongoing activated ability for magic items
proposed_widenings.justification: The item combines an honest passive weapon bonus with a second ability that creates a temporary weapon-bound state, waits for a later hit by that same weapon, then resolves a save-gated rider and expires on first hit or after a timed window. Existing magic-item mechanics admit passive, immediate activation, triggered reaction, or composites of those, but not an activated ongoing rider.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The poison remains for 1 minute or until an attack using this weapon hits a creature. That creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 2d10 Poison damage and have the Poisoned condition for 1 minute.

notes: The passive +1 to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this specific weapon fits today via passive grants plus a specific_item weapon filter. The blocking gap is the coated-blade subgraph, not the underlying save, damage, condition, bonus action cost, or dawn reset.
